old_findings.note: OZ branch-free min still literal with the queue size recomputed inside; now repeated in 5 lines instead of 10 (the peeled iteration is gone)
queue data mapping still raw keccak arithmetic (4 lines)

regressions.old: if cd[32 * idx + _param2 + 36] != sha3(mem[_19 + 32 len mem[_19]]): revert with 'TeleporterMessenger: message ID not from source blockchain'
regressions.source: TeleporterMessenger.sendSpecifiedReceipts: require(calculateMessageID(...) == messageID, "TeleporterMessenger: message ID not from source blockchain")
regressions.issue: The hash is now decoded, but the revert that followed it, named in round 1, is raw memory again with the message as hex words: _18 and _19 are both reads of mem[64] with no write to it in between, and are not identified, so the Error(string) at _18 + 160 is not matched with the revert range at _19 + 160.
regressions.rule: Two reads of mem[64] with no write to mem[64] between them are equal: unify them before matching a revert or call input range with the stores that fill it.

improvements: Named string reverts 35 -> 39 and raw reverts 8 -> 4 ('insufficient gas', 'zero blockchain ID', 'receipt not found', 'SafeERC20TransferFrom: balance not increased'); the message-ID hash decodes as sha3(this.address, _param1, stor2, stor7[...]); a 'return memory' became a value; P3 2 -> 0 (the zero-init loops have no peeled iteration); P2 3 -> 1, P6 8 -> 0, P1 2 -> 0; checks now name the parameters (_param3, _param4) instead of memory reads.
notes: Diff of 1,436 lines; 6 functions changed, effect totals equal except the +1 'if' of the converted rotation in unknowna9a85614 and unknown62448850; condition diffs checked by hand. All 4 source loops unchanged (whiles).
summary: Mostly improved (more named reverts, decoded message-ID hash, rotations without peeled iterations), with one medium regression: the 'message ID not from source blockchain' revert, decoded in round 1, is raw memory again because two equal reads of mem[64] are not unified.
